rules.description: While this unit is visible to a friendly Necron leader unit, add 1 D3 to Move Rolls made for this unit.

rules.description: While this unit is visible to a friendly Necron leader unit, each time this unit selects a target for a ranged weapon, you may select an enemy unit up to 2" further away.

rules.description: While this unit is visible to a friendly Necron leader unit, each time this unit uses Living Metal, improve the result of the roll by 1.

catalogue.comment:
COMPLETE LOADOUT + VARIABLE SIZE + ADDITIONAL COPY COST PASS
All native Necron units and the nested Canoptek Plasmacyte now expose loadouts. Warriors and Immortals use one squad-wide weapon choice. Variable-size units use the minimum-size-root + optional-extra-model pattern. Skorpekh and Ophydian model 1 are the fixed Reap-blade models and are not presented as champions. All native non-Rare Other units use Additional Copy Costs.

LOKHUST DESTROYER MODEL-COUNT LABEL
The fixed minimum-size loadout row now reads 'Lokhust Destroyers 1-2' so the two base models are explicit.
